rss: Faisal Islam: The two big decisions the chancellor must make
title: Candy Prices Might Go Up!
story: The candy makers are thinking about how to keep prices stable. They want to make sure everyone can still enjoy their sweets.
storyBig: Candy companies need to decide how to manage economic pressures to maintain steady pricing. They aim to sustain market optimism while considering potential cost increases.
think: What would happen if candy prices went up?
bull: Candy companies are trying their best to keep prices from rising too much.
bear: If costs go up, your favorite candy might become more expensive.

rss: X-planes: Are they needed in the new era of drones?
title: Are Drones the Future of Toys?
story: Toy makers are wondering if kids prefer flying drones more than airplanes. Drones might become the coolest toy ever!
storyBig: With the rise of affordable drones, toy manufacturers question the relevance of traditional airplane toys. Drones could dominate the aerial toy market by offering more interactive and modern experiences.
think: Would you rather play with a drone or a toy plane?
bull: Drones offer exciting new ways to play and explore!
bear: Toy planes might get less attention if drones become too popular.
